newsitem.title: UK: UK economy booming, inflation controlled - Clarke.
newsitem.headline: UK economy booming, inflation controlled - Clarke.

text.p: The British economy is enjoying strong growth, combined with low inflation, UK Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke said on Thursday.
"Today's figures show that Britain's economy is booming while inflation stays well under control," he said, in a press statement.
Retail price data for March showed the underlying annual growth rate at 2.7 percent, its lowest level since May 1995 but still above the target of 2.5 percent or lower.
"We are making Britain one of the strongest economies in Europe while achieving the longest period of low inflation for half a century," he said.
"Labour's plan for an emergency budget in July would push up inflation through higher taxes and wreck the best economic prospects for a generation," he added.

According to the latest opinion poll, a MORI poll for the Times newspaper, Labour showed a two point increase in its lead over Clarke's ruling Conservative Party to 17 points in the run-up to the May 1 election.
